title: Public demo instance with no execution authority
summary: Decision dossier for a publicly browsable, execution-locked Agent Studio demo built from completed and deployed scenario snapshots. In addition to the pinned two-project seed, Dossier lifecycle, replay, security, hosting, and reset decisions, it defines a six-case scenario pool, recommends SVG Pelican, Shift Ledger, and The Deep Blue as the first benchmark wave, specifies scripted Orchestrator context-chat runs, a four-category TokenEconomy ledger, immutable Result Dossiers and run history, per-case token caps, staged model comparisons, and clear ownership across the demo, Token Economy, the Agent Studio website, and independently deployed outputs.
